_comment: Tuning values loaded once at startup by calibration.py. HSV is OpenCV scale: H 0-179, S 0-255, V 0-255. Restart the program after editing.

defense._comment: goal_px = goal post x separation (px) when we are back at our end of the field. heading_tol = must be within this many degrees of goal heading to back up.

ball_distance._comment: distance_ft = intercept_ft + slope_ft_per_px * ball_r. Closer than close_ft the ball fills the view so we drive straight.
